title: MCUGraves
description: A new updated and optimize grave plugin
body:
# MCUGraves

MCUGraves is a feature-rich death chest plugin for Paper/Spigot 1.21+ that saves players' inventories in protected graves on death — preventing item loss while adding immersion to your server.

---

## ✨ Features

### 🪦 Inventory Protection
When a player dies, a grave is automatically created at their death location containing their entire inventory.

### 💰 Economy Integration
Optional Vault support allows players to pay to claim their items. Claim costs can scale based on previous claims.

### ⏳ Grave Expiry
Configure graves to expire after a certain amount of time to encourage item retrieval.

### 🧭 Grave Compass
Players can obtain a compass that points directly to their active grave.

### 🛒 Grave Shop
Built-in shop system for purchasing grave-related items and utilities.

### 📍 Grave Teleportation
Players can teleport directly to their graves using:
```bash
/grave tp
